nodes.label: Binance official October 1 PoR address set

edges.claim: Bitquery reports approximately 233.5M XRP remained at the receiver and no outgoing transaction had occurred by 06:43 UTC.
Bitquery says each drained hot wallet carried a Binance proof-of-reserves label in its address data; this is not a direct official Binance address-set readback.
CoinDesk's review identifies Ethereum Binance 14 in the October 1 PoR set; it does not identify the five XRPL source addresses.

Binance's official PoR page describes custody assets, wallet ownership checks, customer balance snapshots, Merkle trees, zk-SNARKs and an address download. The October 1 address payload was not retrieved.
Coinbase reports 151,405,263.6 XRP backing 151,403,016.07 cbXRP on Base; calculated excess reserve is 2,247.53 XRP.
None of the five Binance incident source addresses appears in Coinbase's displayed cbXRP reserve-address list. This establishes separate displayed reserve addresses, not separate beneficial owners.
TradRadar reports $1.87B OI, -4.49% daily OI change, -0.0054% funding per eight hours and at least $32.18M liquidations, mostly longs.
CoinDesk reports $38.1M XRP liquidations within $1.53B market-wide 24-hour liquidations; 83.8% of market-wide liquidations were longs.
TrackWhale's 7-day tracked net outflow is -210.09M XRP, but its window includes the Binance theft and cannot be interpreted as voluntary holder withdrawal or net new capital.
CoinDesk cites unnamed sources saying institutions are withdrawing from centralized exchanges; amount, destinations and XRP attribution are unknown.
Four proposed changes are bundled as fixCleanup3_5_0; they were not merged or activated at publication.
The proposal requires more than 80% of trusted validators for two consecutive weeks before activation; the Foundation says no user impact or outsider exploitation is known.
The reported institutional withdrawals are not quantified and cannot be used as an XRP flow or price feature.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The five compromised XRPL source wallets were included in Binance's October 1 XRP PoR and their loss temporarily reduced XRP customer backing.
support: Bitquery says all 17 drained hot wallets carry Binance PoR labels in its address data.
CoinDesk independently identifies Ethereum Binance 14 in the October 1 PoR set.
counter: CoinDesk's named PoR crosswalk is for Ethereum Binance 14, not the five XRPL addresses.
The official Binance address-download payload was not retrieved.
No post-incident XRP-specific reserve ratio or replenishment amount is verified.

competing_hypotheses.claim: XRP is experiencing a broader voluntary post-incident withdrawal from centralized exchanges.
support: TrackWhale displays seven-day tracked net exchange outflow of 210.09M XRP.
CoinDesk reports institutions are withdrawing from centralized exchanges.
counter: TrackWhale's window includes the 233.46M XRP theft and is a limited large-transfer panel.
CoinDesk supplies no amounts, destinations or XRP-specific evidence.
No matched exchange liability/holdings panel confirms voluntary migration.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Binance event coincided with a broad long-led crypto liquidation event that included XRP.
support: CoinDesk/CoinGlass reports $1.53B market-wide liquidations, 83.8% longs and $38.1M XRP liquidations.
TradRadar separately reports at least $32.18M XRP liquidations, predominantly longs, with negative aggregate funding.
counter: Providers and windows differ; no single synchronized venue-complete panel.
CoinDesk reports a subsequent rebound that liquidated shorts.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase has measurable native XRP custody backing cbXRP on Base.
support: Coinbase's official dashboard reports 151.405M XRP reserve against 151.403M cbXRP supply.
counter: One point-in-time snapshot does not establish growth, new spot acquisition or reserve turnover.
Issuer dashboard is not an independent audit.

competing_hypotheses.claim: fixCleanup3_5_0 could strengthen XRPL issuer control and institutional compliance for restricted tokens.
support: Four proposed changes close exceptions for unapproved holders and AMM pool participation.
counter: Not merged or activated; no affected users or exploitation known.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Institutions may diversify away from centralized-exchange custody after the Binance incident.
support: CoinDesk cites unnamed sources reporting withdrawals and trading-book rebalancing.
counter: No amounts, destinations, assets or independent flow data are disclosed.

source_independence.bitquery_trm_bithomp: Different analytics/explorer providers inspect the same public XRPL transactions; the underlying events are not independent.
source_independence.coindesk_coinglass: CoinDesk's market liquidation totals rely on CoinGlass; treat as one market-data lineage.
source_independence.tradradar: Separate aggregator and different exchange coverage/cutoff; do not average with CoinGlass without harmonizing windows.
source_independence.trackwhale: Separate tracker over the same public XRPL ledger; limited large-transfer sample, incident-contaminated.
source_independence.coinbase: Official issuer dashboard, not independent audit evidence.
source_independence.institutional_withdrawal_claim: Single anonymous-source media report; no quantified independent corroboration.
source_independence.xrpl_restricted_tokens: CoinDesk report of developer proposals and XRPL Foundation statement; not an activated protocol observation.
